task_completion.description: Select the Standalone Battery (Single Owner) model in SAM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SAM 'Configuration' or 'New Project' screen showing 'Standalone Battery' and 'Single Owner' selected.

task_completion.description: Configure the battery system for 10 MW / 40 MWh capacity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Battery System' page showing Nameplate capacity or Power/Energy inputs set to 10 MW and 40 MWh.

task_completion.description: Enable both Calendar Life and Cycle Life degradation models.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Battery Life' page showing checkboxes or selections for both 'Calendar Life' and 'Cycle Life' degradation models enabled.

task_completion.description: Configure manual dispatch: Charge 00:00-04:00 and Discharge 16:00-20:00 at max capacity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Battery Dispatch' page showing a schedule grid or table with charging (negative power) during hours 0-4 and discharging (positive power) during hours 16-20.

task_completion.description: Set the analysis period to 20 years.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Financial Parameters' or 'System Costs' page showing 'Analysis Period' set to 20 years.

task_completion.description: Run the simulation to generate degradation data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Results' page or a progress bar indicating the simulation has completed successfully.

task_completion.description: Extract annual State of Health and save to the specified JSON file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the file '/home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/battery_degradation_report.json' with the correct JSON structure, 20 SOH values, and the year crossing 80%.

integrity.description: The agent used the SAM GUI to configure the model rather than just writing a script to generate the JSON.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent navigating through SAM's tabs (Battery System, Battery Life, Dispatch) and clicking buttons.

integrity.description: The agent extracted results from the SAM 'Results' or 'Data Tables' tab.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent viewing the 'Battery State of Health' or 'Capacity' time series/annual data within the SAM results interface.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the final JSON into a file without performing the simulation steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows a logical progression from configuration to simulation to data extraction.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The analysis period must be exactly 20 years. The output file must be /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/battery_degradation_report.json. The 'year_crossing_80_pct' must be the first year the State of Health drops below 80.0%. The chemistry is Lithium-ion NMC. The dispatch must show 4 hours of charging at the start of the day and 4 hours of discharging in the late afternoon.
